lines.text: Wine is a mocker, a king's terror is like a lion's roar, and the slacker does not plow in season.
A man of wealth draws out the deep waters of a man's heart, and a king sifts out all evil with his eyes.
Do not love sleep or you will grow poor, and food gained by fraud later fills the mouth with gravel.
Avoid the gossip, whoever curses his father or mother will have his lamp put out, and one should wait on the LORD.
Gold and many soldiers preserve a king, the glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
